ns2:section.sectionText: This course is part of EMBA "Immersion Week" and is open to all Executive, Full-time, and Professional students. The class takes place May 25-28, 2011. Class will meet from 8:30 a.m. - 4:00 p.m. on May 25-27, and 7:45 a.m. - 3:15 p.m. on May 28. Students must contact Jane White at jgwhite@illinois.edu to select specific class topics.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MBA:Exec MBA Ilini Ctr-UIUC, MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC, or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
